_comment: Atlas Growth :: US residential in-ground swimming-pool builders, nationwide, warm states first (ICP-pools.md). Engine config for google-maps-scrape. Job-specific values live ONLY here. Qualification is LENIENT by operator decision 2026-10-11: no review floor, no website rule; the universe is cut by type/name denies here and the real Qualified/Review/Exclude verdict comes from the site-text gate (STEP 5e, classify-prompt.md).

categories._r: STEP 2: the ONLY native category for this trade is 'Swimming pool contractor' (references/google-maps-categories.md; the siblings are supply store / repair service / cleaning service, which are the adjacent-but-wrong set). Every other brief phrase is a keyword row (kw:pool, P3) that searchmaps.php fuzzy-matches against names and descriptions — that is where the builder typed 'General contractor' or 'Landscaper' surfaces.

scrape_tuning._r: Same settings as the US generator run (measured ~2.1-2.6 Maps calls per runsheet row). paginate:true pages each viewport via offset; max_pages 6 x limit 150 caps a dense metro; max_depth 1 = at most one quadrant split.

qualify_rules._r: 1. Must-drop PRIMARY types: the 'pool' homonym (billiards), places to swim (public/hotel/apartment/club pools, swim schools), and the venues/offices that answer 'swimming pool' queries. Primary-only on purpose: a builder carrying an incidental 'Hot tub store' or 'Swimming pool supply store' tag must survive to the site-text gate. Substring-matched, so every term is multi-word or unambiguous (IMPROVEMENTS: short deny terms delete whole ICPs).
qualify_rules.label: off_icp_type

qualify_rules._r: 2. Must-drop by NAME (always fires, primary or secondary type): the billiards homonym, big-box and pool-retail chains that sell but never build, swim schools / public aquatic facilities, and civic bodies. Every term is multi-word or a brand (substring trap).
qualify_rules.label: name_deny

qualify_rules._r: 3. Positive allow on google_types-ANY (never primary). Keeps every row Google tagged with any pool/spa type — contractor, supply store, cleaning, repair, hot tub — and lets the site-text gate separate builders from service/retail (the brief keeps a builder that also cleans). Rows WITHOUT any pool tag are dropped here as not_in_icp and come back two ways at $0: (a) keyword rows (icp_type kw:pool) go to classify per SKILL STEP 5b keyword recovery; (b) generic contractor/landscaper types whose NAME says pool are re-admitted by recover-generic-pools-config.json.
qualify_rules.label: not_in_icp

_no_review_floor: Operator 2026-10-11: LENIENT. No review_count floor (coverage over precision; the brief wants the largest possible list and the $30k+ profile is judged from site text, not review volume). Re-add {review_count >= N} here if the Review bucket is too large to work.
_no_website_rule: Deliberately NO {website, exists} rule: collapse-domains.js routes no-website and shared-host rows to the STEP 5d recovery track AFTER the denies have run, so a blocklisted chain cannot ride in through the recovery track.

brand_families._r: Keep every branch, flag the brand (same directive as foundation repair). Multi-location builders and franchise systems that appear on Maps under these names; matched as lowercase substrings of '<name> <root_domain>', so every term is distinctive. Manufacturer-dealer networks (Latham, Leisure Pools, Thursday Pools, Imagine Pools) are listed because a dealer branch sometimes trades under the maker's name; the site-text gate decides whether the row is a factory (not_pool) or an installing dealer (inground_builder).

owner_query._r: search-owner.js has no working backend (scraper.tech SERP discontinued). Owner-finding runs on the in-session read + sweep rungs; a DataForSEO backend is a pending engine change (see RUN-NOTES).
